title: Querdian Overview
description: Querdian authorization proxy: traffic, latency, upstream health, enforcement, auth, snapshots and policy readiness.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Total proxied requests per second.

panels.title: Deny ratio
panels.description: Share of requests denied by policy.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests that ended in decision=error (Querdian or upstream failure).

panels.title: Policies not ready
panels.description: Policies with ready=false. Red when above zero.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration over the selected filters.

panels.title: Snapshot generation
panels.description: Generation of the active policy snapshot (max across replicas).

panels.title: Request rate by decision
panels.description: Requests per second split by decision (allow/deny/error).

panels.title: Request rate by reason (non-allowed)
panels.description: Denied and failed requests per second by reason code (e.g. denied_label, no_grant, unauthenticated, upstream_error).

panels.title: Request rate by backend and endpoint
panels.description: Requests per second per backend and route template.

panels.title: Request latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Quantiles from the classic _bucket series. Exemplar dots link to the trace in Tempo (requires exemplarTraceIdDestinations on the Prometheus data source, label trace_id).

panels.title: Latency by backend (p95)
panels.description: p95 request duration per backend.

panels.title: Latency by decision (p95)
panels.description: p95 by decision; deny paths should be far faster than allow.

panels.title: Upstream errors per backend (5xx and transport errors)
panels.description: Rate of upstream responses with code 5xx or code=error (transport failure) per backend.

panels.title: Upstream error ratio per backend
panels.description: Fraction of upstream requests that were 5xx or transport errors.

panels.title: Upstream responses by code
panels.description: Upstream request rate by status code.

panels.title: Upstream latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Upstream duration quantiles (classic buckets) with trace exemplars.

panels.title: Fan-out terms distribution
panels.description: Distribution of DNF terms per resolved request (= upstream fan-out), by classic bucket.

panels.title: Fan-out terms quantiles
panels.description: Quantiles of DNF terms per request. A rising p99 approaches the term cap (policy_too_complex / query_too_complex denials).

panels.title: Rewrite duration p95 by language / strategy
panels.description: p95 time spent rewriting queries.

panels.title: Rewrite rate by language / strategy
panels.description: Rewrites per second.

panels.title: Auth failures by reason
panels.description: Authentication failures per second by reason.

panels.title: Snapshot generation
panels.description: Active snapshot generation per instance. Divergence between replicas indicates lag.

panels.title: Snapshot rebuilds by result
panels.description: Rebuilds per second by result.

panels.title: Time since last rebuild
panels.description: Derived: time since the rebuild counter last increased, looking back over the dashboard range at 1m resolution. Empty if no rebuild occurred in range.

panels.title: Policies by kind and readiness
panels.description: Number of policies per kind and ready state.

panels.title: Policies not ready
panels.description: Red when any policy has ready=false.
